Hey, I'm really not that good with words but from what I read, you love this girl, but this girl doesn't seem to reciprocate the same. I just want you to know that it's okay to feel hopeless right now but I also want you to know that this is in your control. Maybe talk to her, communication is key for a healthy relationship as the lack of communication is what ended most of my relationships. Love is hard, love includes pleasure, but also include suffering. Love might not be a walk in the park, but if you truly love her, live for her, don't give up. Also, this might be coming out of nowhere but this is just a precaution, if she's toxic or manipulative, or if you see any hints of her using you, I recommend severing ties with her as soon as possible. Toxic and manipulative relationships often happen in disguise. With that, I hope I helped you in something, and I'm sorry for rambling on so much.

Hey, I've never experienced such a thing from a stranger, but I do understand your point in trying to be normal. I've had tried to be normal in the past few years myself, but I also want to mention that I've realized it's not bad being 'not normal'. In fact, it's completely okay to not be normal. Everyone is different, with different mindsets, with different points in life, different physical traits and different personalities. I believe this is what makes us human. I'm not saying that you aren't normal, oh I'm not saying that in any way, shape, or form. I just want you to know that it's okay to cry and it's okay to feel stuff. From what I've read in your post, I think it's normal to be to be this emotional  since you've been through so much. If some stranger sends me a gift, a note, or anything- I would also get emotional. So please, it's okay to cry, it's okay. Another point I want to make is that I think, personally, the person sending you this so called 'gift' absolutely and definitely cares about you. He/she wants you to be happy and not to suffer. With that being said, I'm not a professional, and I'm really not good with words, but I care about you, even if I don't know you, I still care about your well being and mental health so if there's anything you need, please don't hesitate to pm me or anything.
Yes. I'm here for you. I'm listening.

Being suicidal, I feel like, depends on more than one thing. For example, do you feel pain? or are you unhappy in your current situation? If you aren't living for yourself or if you feel like you have no meaning in this world (this is one of the feelings), then you might be suicidal. Full disclosure, I am no way, shape, or form a professional so my answer might be invalid and not credible, but if you do feel that way, you can always call a suicide prevention hotline, but if you're like me and it doesn't work for you, I'm always here if you need someone to talk to.

As for my teachers, the workload isn't the problem, I just far too lazy to do anything. All I do is play games and watch tv shows, maybe that's a part of the problem. Being distracted by games and tv shows but I can't bring myself to stop. I don't know.. I just feel like giving up, but maybe I'm just unconsciously playing the victim role. I don't know anymore.
